description: Canonical ontology entity types for a professional services firm.

types.name: Project
types.description: A scoped engagement delivered for a client.

types.name: Deliverable
types.description: A specific output or artifact produced within a project.

types.name: Milestone
types.description: A time-bound checkpoint within a project.

types.name: Invoice
types.description: A billing document issued to a client.

types.name: Risk
types.description: A potential issue that could affect delivery or revenue.

types.name: Lead
types.description: A prospective client in the sales pipeline.

types.name: Proposal
types.description: A formal commercial proposal submitted to a prospect.

types.name: Resource
types.description: A person or capacity unit assigned to project work.

types.name: ChangeRequest
types.description: A formal request to modify project scope, timeline, or budget.

relationships.description: A client owns one or more projects.
A client is billed via invoices.
A lead receives a commercial proposal.
A won lead converts to a client.
A resource is assigned to a project.
A project may be subject to change requests.
